decision: No unique universal mathematically minimal three-round schedule without measured loss duration distribution, rate mix and recovery deadline. Two candidate families are Pareto alternatives. Earlier unconditional 2/18 recommendation SUPERSEDED. PRODUCT NOT CHANGED.
